Lena (Finance): Noticed ~$9.6k of Feb GPU spend landed in an unallocated bucket. Labels null in export. Anyone seeing this? :thinking:

Omar (Cloud Ops): ugh. which projects? can you paste the BQ output?

Lena (Finance): Quick top-line from BQ: project=experiments-sweep (~6.1k), project=ci-builds (~2.0k), misc smalls (~1.5k). Full CSV in the ticket.

billing-bot: billing export available: exp_20260228_0700.

Omar (Cloud Ops): experiments-sweep ran a large preemptible sweep on 2026-02-25 and our labeling wrapper failed on retries — likely root cause. I'll pull instance IDs + audit log mapping.

Priya (Vendor Ops): pinging reseller if any reservation/residual assignment affects these lines.

Lena (Finance): For chargeback approval I need: (1) CSV mapping instance_id -> owner/team, (2) proposed allocation split, (3) confirmation of fixes to prevent recurrence. Can we have provisional allocations today?

Omar (Cloud Ops): provisional split: experiments team 6.1k, CI 2.0k, misc 1.5k. I'll drop the CSV into BT-10400 and add a runbook patch that auto-adds cost_center on job create.

Priya (Vendor Ops): reseller says no reservation mismatch.

Lena (Finance): OK provisional approved pending CSV. Also request budgets: experiments-sweep $8k/month, ci-builds $3k/month with alerts at 80/90/100% to #finance and owners.

Omar (Cloud Ops): will create budgets and the daily untagged digest to #finance. Also adding an org policy to require cost_center on compute.create.

billing-bot: ticket BT-10400 created (provisional allocation).

Lena (Finance): thanks — tagging this for month-end close. We'll finalize after CSV verification. :thumbsup:
